Name: (SVE) Pokefy - A Pokemon Mod for SVE
Author: Coupangg
Description:
[center][font=Courier New][size=6][b][color=#f6b26b]
Pokefy for Stardew Valley Expanded
[/color][/b][/size][/font][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529][center][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/12047/12047-1652614294-1486591208.png[/img][/b]﻿[/center]

StravaJD[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]FlashShifter[/url] both made mods that I can't play without and I decided to create the connection between those two worlds.

The mod changes every animal sprite added by SVE, every monster, fish, map and portrait to fit the Pokemon world.

Some npcs are also changed but it mostly is non-human npcs. So any mod that changes the textures of human npcs should be compatible.
List of changed npcs /!\ spoiler alert /!\ :
[spoiler]Dusty; Apples; Peaches; Krobus (To fit Pokefy); Dewey; Dwarf; Peaches[/spoiler]


[b][center][font=Courier New][color=#f6b26b][size=5]♪ Requirements ♫[/size][/color][/font][/center][/b]
♦ Content Patcher
♦ Stardew Valley Expanded
♦ Pokefy is not required though highly recommended.

[b][font=Courier New][center][size=5][color=#f6b26b]♪ Planned Updates ♫[/color][/size][/center][/font][/b][center]
FlashShifter is a hard working individual, so keeping up with every update that adds content related to monsters, fishes will result in new updates.
[/center]♦ Add more pictures to the mod's page!
♦ Find out how to change the shop portraits added by SVE. Can't seem to find the directory, If anyone has any clue, I'd love to know!
♦ Add a config file for users to choose if they want some retexture to show up or not.
